car.sports-car.name: High-performance sports
car.sports-car.desc: Low, wide and built for the fastest straights. Watch out for springy purple splitting slimes.
car.sports-car.drive: power rotates the tail; careful throttle pays
car.lightweight-sports.name: Lightweight sports
car.lightweight-sports.desc: Short, light and precise. Trades some straight-line speed for quick cornering rhythm.
car.lightweight-sports.drive: a light rear end that changes direction quickly
car.jeep.name: Off-roader
car.jeep.desc: Short wheelbase, tall cabin. Pushes through sticky ground.
car.jeep.drive: four driven tyres, with a tall body's movement
car.pickup-travel-trailer.name: Pickup + trailer
car.pickup-travel-trailer.desc: A long bed and a full travel trailer. Leave room for the rear axle.
car.pickup-travel-trailer.drive: steady towing traction; the trailer remains passive
car.monster-truck.name: Monster Truck
car.monster-truck.desc: A lifted pickup on giant tyres, with long-travel suspension and a deep V8 rumble.
car.monster-truck.drive: giant tyres pull together under a slow, tall chassis
car.school-bus.name: School bus
car.school-bus.desc: Heavy and long. Brake early and give corners some room.
car.school-bus.drive: rear driven, mild power and no drift-car snap
car.retro-van.name: Retro van
car.retro-van.desc: Seafoam and warm white. Its tall body rewards smooth steering.
car.retro-van.drive: gentle rear drive rewards smooth throttle
car.city-pod.drive: easy to place; too much power pushes the nose wide

track.beijing.name: Tiananmen Square
track.beijing.blurb: A big lap of Tiananmen Square: off at the gate, along Chang'an Avenue, then at Zhengyangmen.
track.beijing.fact: Zhengyangmen's gate tower stands 43.65 m tall, the tallest of Beijing's nine old inner-city gate towers.
track.shanghai.name: Lujiazui by Night
track.shanghai.blurb: North up Pucheng Road at three supertowers, through Lujiazui, then down Century Avenue at the Pearl.
track.shanghai.fact: Lujiazui's four towers got taller in the order they were built: Pearl Tower 1994, Jin Mao 1999, SWFC 2008, Shanghai Tower 2015.
track.lhasa.name: Potala Palace
track.lhasa.blurb: Straight at the Potala Palace, through the white stupa gate, across the palace square facing it, then round its east side and back.
track.lhasa.fact: The white stupa gate between Chakpori and the Potala is where British troops entered Lhasa in 1904.
track.zhangjiajie.name: Zhangjiajie Pillars
track.zhangjiajie.blurb: A road across the Yuanjiajie plateau, sandstone pillars rising out of the mist.
track.zhangjiajie.fact: The Southern Sky Column inspired Avatar's floating mountains and was renamed Avatar Hallelujah Mountain in 2010.
track.fuji.name: Lake Kawaguchi & Fuji
track.fuji.blurb: Along Lake Kawaguchi with Mount Fuji ahead across the water, over the lake bridge and along the south shore to finish.
track.fuji.fact: Kawaguchiko Ohashi, built in 1971, is the only bridge across any of the Fuji Five Lakes.
track.dubai.name: Burj Khalifa
track.dubai.blurb: From Business Bay with the Burj Khalifa ahead, round the boulevard's arc and straight at its foot.
track.dubai.fact: The Burj Khalifa is 828 m tall; its steel spire alone is about 200 m, nearly a quarter of it.
track.istanbul.name: Sultanahmet
track.istanbul.blurb: From the Hippodrome past Hagia Sophia, then down to the sea road along the Marmara.
track.istanbul.fact: Six minarets matched the mosque in Mecca, so Sultan Ahmed paid for Mecca's seventh.
track.rome.name: Colosseum
track.rome.blurb: From the Circus Maximus straight at the Arch of Constantine, round the Colosseum and down the Imperial Forums to the Vittoriano.
track.rome.fact: The Colosseum once raised a retractable awning on 240 wooden masts to shade its crowd.
track.paris.name: Arc to Eiffel
track.paris.blurb: Up the Champs-Élysées, round the Arc de Triomphe and over the Pont d'Iéna to the foot of the Eiffel Tower.
track.paris.fact: The Eiffel Tower was due to come down in 1909 and survived because it made a fine radio antenna.
track.giza.name: Pyramids of Giza
track.giza.blurb: Up from the desert onto the plateau, at Khafre then Khufu, and down the Sphinx road to finish.
track.giza.fact: The Great Pyramid was the world's tallest structure for almost 3,800 years, until Lincoln Cathedral.
track.amboseli.name: Amboseli Savanna
track.amboseli.blurb: A dirt track south across the savanna, Kilimanjaro's snowcap dead ahead.
track.amboseli.fact: Kilimanjaro stands in Tanzania, but the best place to see it is Amboseli in Kenya.
track.new-york.name: Lower Manhattan
track.new-york.blurb: From Broadway at Trinity Church, round the World Trade Center, finishing at the foot of the Brooklyn Bridge.
track.new-york.fact: Liberty stands on Fort Wood, a star fort built in 1808, almost 80 years before the statue.
track.sydney.name: Over the Bridge, Round the Opera House
track.sydney.blurb: Over the Harbour Bridge, up Macquarie Street at the Opera House, then round it on the waterfront.
track.sydney.fact: Every shell of the Opera House is cut from the same 75.2 m sphere, the 'spherical solution'.
car.beijing-sightseeing-bus.name: Double-Decker Tour Bus
car.beijing-sightseeing-bus.desc: A red double-decker sightseeing bus: tall, long and steady, with the best view from upstairs.
car.shanghai-classic-sedan.name: Classic Boxy Sedan
car.shanghai-classic-sedan.desc: The boxy nineties saloon that filled every street: tough and easy to drive.
car.shanghai-classic-sedan.drive: Middle of the road, easy to hold
car.lhasa-plateau-suv.name: Plateau 4x4
car.lhasa-plateau-suv.desc: A 4x4 built for the plateau: high ground clearance and four-wheel grip.
car.zhangjiajie-shuttle.name: Park Shuttle Bus
car.zhangjiajie-shuttle.desc: The scenic-area shuttle that runs the plateau roads all day.
car.fuji-kei-truck.name: Kei Truck
car.fuji-kei-truck.desc: A tiny flat-bed kei truck: narrow, light and nimble.
car.fuji-kei-truck.drive: Light, nimble, turns on a coin
car.dubai-supercar.name: Desert Supercar
car.dubai-supercar.desc: A mid-engined supercar that nobody catches on a straight.
car.dubai-supercar.drive: Very fast; needs a light touch
car.istanbul-dolmus.name: Dolmuş Minibus
car.istanbul-dolmus.desc: The shared yellow minibus that stops wherever you wave.
car.istanbul-dolmus.drive: High centre of gravity; no sudden turns
car.rome-roadster.name: Italian Roadster
car.rome-roadster.desc: A small red roadster: light, low and a joy to hear.
car.paris-tin-snail.name: Tin Snail
car.paris-tin-snail.desc: The old soft-sprung small car that leans through corners and never tips.
car.giza-microbus.name: Cairo Microbus
car.giza-microbus.desc: Cairo's white microbus, full of passengers and still charging.
car.amboseli-safari.name: Safari Pop-Top
car.amboseli-safari.desc: A pop-top safari 4x4, most at home on a dirt track.
car.new-york-limo.name: Stretch Limo
car.new-york-limo.desc: A stretch limo so long you cannot see its end; plan every corner.
car.sydney-ute.name: Aussie Ute
